Bill splitter

Enter the subtotal, choose a tip and the number of people. Every cent of the total is allocated. No payment is sent — this only calculates.

Enter values to see the split.

    total = subtotal × (1 + tip ÷ 100), rounded to cents · base share = floor(total ÷ people) · leftover cents go one each to the first people in the list, so the shares always sum to the total.
